setup: Create an isolated uv venv with CPython3.12; install numpy==2.4.6 tensorflow==2.21.0 ai-edge-litert==2.3.0 pymicro-features==2.0.2 soundfile==0.14.0 h5py==3.14.0 scipy==1.17.0. Disable TensorFlow GPU and use CPU2threads. Native MicroFrontend100 zero hops and repository features(np.zeros(16000,int16)) both produced the recorded98x40 UINT16 bytes. This smoke does not run learned inference.
limits: Real native frontend and runtime imports only. No waveform/corpus read, audio I/O, board write or model admission.
